term: change between two times (ChangesBetween x r t₁ t₂)
definition: ChangesBetween x r t₁ t₂: x changes in respect r between the earlier time t₁ and the later time t₂ of a duration frame (q.9 a.1: mutatur quocumque modo). It covers motion (alteration, growth, locomotion) and, unless a premise excludes it, generation and corruption. It is not being moved (MovedIn, DEF-MOTION-AS-REDUCTION): the open premise STMT-CHANGE-OF-PERSISTING-SUBJECT-IS-MOTION makes only a change whose subject is present at both ends a motion. Structural properties: none assumed. Example: water heated between noon and one. Counterexample: a Cambridge change (becoming shorter than a growing child) on views that deny it is a real change. In Lean a parameter B -> R -> T -> T -> Prop.
